text: Docling is designed as a simple, self-contained python library with permissive license, running entirely locally on commodity hardware
Typical tables require between 2 and 6 seconds to be processed on a standard CPU
feeds a high-resolution page image (216 dpi) to the OCR engine
The Docling pipeline feeds page images at 72 dpi resolution
While it is faster and more memory efficient than the default docling-parse backend, it will come at the expense of worse quality results
Text content inside figures is currently dropped, the caption is retained and linked to the figure in the JSON representation
